Uses a lossless audio codec, if one is available for the codec. If you set`audioCodec`, it takes priority over `preferLossless`.

## CLI flag

```text
--prefer-lossless
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#preferlossless)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#preferlossless)
- [`combineChunks()`](/docs/renderer/combine-chunks#preferlossless)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setPreferLosslessAudio(true);
```
